Container.Name: Vaultisse
Container.Overview: Vaultisse is a self-hosted app for tracking, organizing, and lending physical book collections. This template runs the app itself; it needs a PostgreSQL server to connect to (its own container, or one you already run) with the schema from assets/db/databaseSchema.sql imported once. See the Project link, DEPLOYMENT.md, for full setup instructions.
Container.Description: Self-hosted book tracking & lending library manager. Requires a separate PostgreSQL server.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on and is published on

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Hostname/IP of your PostgreSQL server — e.g. another container's name on the same custom network, or your Unraid IP if Postgres runs elsewhere

Config.Name: FRONT_END_URL
Config.Description: Public URL this app is served at, e.g. https://books.example.com or http://TOWER_IP:3000. Used for CORS/CSP.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign login sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: ALLOW_DEV_AUTH
Config.Description: NEVER set true unless only you can reach this container. Bypasses login entirely with a fake session.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set true only if this sits behind a reverse proxy or tunnel (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare Tunnel, ...) that sets X-Forwarded-* headers. Leave false if you're publishing the port directly.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: enables ISBN metadata lookups via Google Books instead of the free Open Library fallback

Config.Name: LIBRARYTHING_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: third cover-lookup fallback (after Google Books and Open Library). Free devkey: https://www.librarything.com/services/keys.php

Config.Name: LOGGER_PATH
Config.Description: Do not change — must match the Logs path above

Config.Name: API_PORT
Config.Description: Do not change — must match the WebUI Port container-side value above
